description: This file defines an interface for a composition buffer used in the WPEFramework project, including related nested classes and enumerations for handling buffer data, planes, and iteration.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer
classes.description: An interface representing a hardware-optimized frame buffer with methods for managing buffer references, retrieving buffer properties, and handling planes.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IPlane
classes.description: Represents a single plane within the composition buffer, providing access to its data pointer, stride, and offset.

classes.name: ICompositionBuffer::IIterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing the planes within the buffer, allowing validation, reset, and iteration.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the buffer object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count for the buffer object.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns an identifier for the buffer.

methods.name: Planes
methods.description: Provides an iterator to access the planes of the buffer.

methods.name: Completed
methods.description: Indicates that processing on the buffer's planes is complete.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Marks the buffer for scanout or display output.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the buffer in pixels.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Returns the pixel format layout (fourcc code).

methods.name: Modifier
methods.description: Returns the pixel arrangement modifier for hardware optimization.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the data type of the buffer (INVALID, DMA, RAW).
